versionGroups.label: Single-consumer dependencies stay literal — a catalog entry with one reader is indirection, not a contract. Re-evaluate an entry the moment a second unit declares it.
Everything else must come from the pnpm catalog in pnpm-workspace.yaml. The twelve Press units and root must not drift on shared dependencies.
versionGroups.//dependencyTypes: Only real dependency declarations. `local` is a package's OWN .version field, which is not a dependency and cannot be catalogued (syncpack says so itself: RefuseToCatalogLocal). `pnpmOverrides` is the advisory-floor block in pnpm-workspace.yaml — a single root-owned mechanism that no unit declares, so it cannot drift between units and a catalog entry for it would be meaningless.
